title: Digital Nomad Visa: What It Is and How to Apply
seo_title: Digital Nomad Visa: Meaning, Rules and Application
meta_description: Learn what a digital nomad visa permits, who qualifies, which documents are common and how to compare official rules before you apply.
excerpt: A digital nomad visa can legalise a longer stay while you work remotely for foreign employers or clients, but every country sets different limits. Use this guide to compare routes and prepare a defensible application.
